messages:
Maya (packaging): heads up — prepping 2.0.0-rc1 private/vpc installer handoff. target canary window TOMORROW 09:00-11:00 PT. artifacts built: installer.tar.gz, sealed-oci-bundle.tar.gz, manifest.json :package:
Eli (releases): thanks. which signer will we use? KMS rotation yesterday might impact TTLs.
Maya (packaging): using kms://projects/redwood/keys/release-signer-2. key TTL set to 48h. cosign sigs attached under /artifacts/cosign/.
Sanjay: noted. ops: can we reserve 3 canary hosts in us-west-2 and one fallback in eu-west-1?
OpsQA: reserving now. also will run checksum validation after transport. expecting sha256 sums in manifest.
Tara (security): double-checking that cosign key is registered in HSM. also need attestations for the offline bundle per compliance.
Maya (packaging): yes attestation JSON included: /artifacts/attestations/att-2.0.0-rc1.json. sign command used:
```
cosign sign --key ksm://release-signer-2 sealed-oci-bundle.tar.gz
```
Eli (releases): deploy-bot config for this run? can we pin the staging deploy to tag `prodish-2-rc1` and disable auto-promote?
Maya (packaging): deploy-bot config updated: `deploybot apply --env=private-staging --pin=prodish-2-rc1 --auto-promote=false`
DeployBot: deploy accepted. canary slots: 3. rollback-on-failure: true. health-checks: /health, 5s interval, 2 consecutive fails -> rollback.
Sanjay: good. rollback plan: if canary fails, we roll to 1.9.6 pinned image set and open incident channel. who owns the rollback?
Eli (releases): releases oncall will own rollback steps; packaging will prepare the 1.9.6 pinned manifest.
Maya (packaging): prepping pinned manifest now. ETA 40m.
OpsQA: running pre-transport smoke now: verifying manifest hashes and signing metadata. small mismatch on layer 3 size vs manifest in sealed-oci-bundle.tar.gz — investigating.
Maya (packaging): hmm can you paste the diff?
OpsQA: pasted below:
```
manifest.json: layer[2].size = 10485760 but tar shows 10485768
```
Sanjay: likely gzip padding. we should normalize by `--no-block` tar flags. fix and rebuild, don't rotate cosign yet.
Maya (packaging): rebuilding with consistent flags. will push new artifact under /artifacts/rc1-rebuild/ and bump checksum.
Tara (security): hold on cosign until new artifact pushed. also adjust attestation to reference new sha256.
Maya (packaging): done. new checksum: sha256:abcd1234... (shortened). pushed and updated manifest.
DeployBot: observed new artifact; re-validating signatures... signatures OK.
Eli (releases): release notes — I can draft the changelog for 2.0.0-rc1. Maya can you add packaging notes about the tar flags and the cosign TTL?
Maya (packaging): added a short note in release_notes/private-2.0.0-rc1.md: "fixed tar padding issue; do not rotate signer within 24h of handoff"
OpsQA: canary hosts allocated. starting cutover at 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post a reminder 30m before.
Sanjay: one more: transport window — we need to use the locked transport lane (bridge-3) to avoid mirror conflicts. OpsQA, confirm mirror quota.
OpsQA: mirror quota checked: bridge-3 OK. transfer window reserved 08:45-09:30 PT.
Tara (security): final checklist: cosign sigs present, attestation, KMS key in HSM, audit log entries enabled. all ✅ from security.
Eli (releases): perfect. one last ask: tag the canary run in the release notes with `canary-run-id: rb-6312345678` so we can correlate telemetry later.
Maya (packaging): done.
Eli (releases): thanks everyone — we’ll meet in #release-war-room if anything blows up. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: canary started at 2026-04-01T09:00:12Z on hosts [ip-10-0-5-12, ip-10-0-5-13, ip-10-0-5-14]. health-checks passing so far.
OpsQA: monitoring latency and error budget now. will report after 30m.
Maya (packaging): if we need immediate rollback, use `deploybot rollback --to-tag=prodish-1.9.6` and notify #incidents.
Eli (releases): documented in the runbook. closing here, will post final status after 30m canary check. :white_check_mark:
